low_sodium.name: low_sodium
low_sodium.label: Low sodium

low_sugar.name: low_sugar

heart.name: heart
heart.label: Heart
heart.blurb: Saturated fat and sodium together, the way heart-health guidance frames it.
heart.coverage_note: Saturated fat is on 63% and sodium on 79% of products.

nutrition_first.label: Nutrition first
nutrition_first.blurb: The Yuka/EWG ordering - the nutrition panel leads and ingredients support it.
nutrition_first.coverage_note: Closest to how mainstream food scores work; included so you can compare.
